title: Jack and the Tube That Waited for Rain
synopsis: A delivery to Pine Park turns out to be a rain gauge, giving Jack something new to watch and Rex a puzzle about where water comes from.
continuity_state: Before: Dan delivered orange cones to Ms. Pam and has a labeled parcel for Pine Park. Pine Park is open, with its established tall pine, bench, gravel loop, and Pancake Hill. After: Aunt Jo mounts a simple clear rain gauge upright at an open, level grassy spot by the Pine Park entrance, away from the tall pine canopy. It is empty at the end of the episode and available for later rain stories. Jack draws its measurement marks in his growing notebook; Dan has completed the Pine Park stop.
